paper.title: The Key to State Reduction in Linear Attention: A Rank-based Perspective

scientific_question: Does paper-aligned DRRQR reduction of Qwen3.6-27B GDN per-head Q/K dimension from 128 to 64, or the preregistered independent Dk96 fallback if Dk64 fails quality, improve complete-model serving performance on four Ascend 910B4 NPUs while retaining quality on the frozen delivered suite?

forbidden: the external Qwen3.5 service and its port
resource_boundaries.release_requirement: All exact experiment containers exited, port8225 closed, host NPU4-7 empty

treatment.algorithm: DRRQR with joint Q/K per-head selection
treatment.recovery_finetuning: not part of the primary pre-RFT A/B; if needed it requires a separate treatment identity

calibration.paper_original: FineWeb-Edu, 16 batches, batch size 1, sequence length 2048
calibration.ascend_adaptation: first 16 source-ordered rows of delivered LongBench-v2 data.json, tokenized with the target model and truncated to exactly 2048 tokens
calibration.claim_boundary: This is a documented platform adaptation and is not the paper's FineWeb-Edu calibration corpus.

quality_contract.niah_plus: not run because authoritative delivered data is absent; no substitute

decision_contract.primary_treatment: Dk128 to Dk64, 50% Q/K state reduction
decision_contract.quality_gate: For each dataset, baseline mean accuracy minus treatment mean accuracy must be no greater than that dataset's observed baseline three-run accuracy range.
decision_contract.quality_gate_reason: Use measured repeat variability from the same model, evaluator and runtime contract rather than an invented universal tolerance.
decision_contract.serving_benefit_gate: Treatment mean output_tokens_per_second must exceed baseline mean and treatment mean benchmark_duration_s must be below baseline mean. Report all TTFT and TPOT changes without selectively omitting regressions.
decision_contract.robustness_label: Call a performance effect repeat-separated only when the complete baseline and treatment three-run ranges do not overlap in the beneficial direction; otherwise call it an observed mean change.
decision_contract.profile_gate: A final adoption decision requires a same-workload native baseline-versus-selected-treatment profile or an explicit documented profiling limitation; paper H100 training microbenchmark numbers are contextual only.
decision_contract.fallback: If Dk64 fails any dataset quality gate, reject Dk64 for the frozen workload and evaluate Dk96 (25% pruning) as a new treatment identity. A roughly 20% option may follow only after runtime shape/alignment validation.
decision_contract.forbidden: Do not average across datasets to hide a failed dataset, do not pool HYPIC evidence, and do not claim paper-exact reproduction because the calibration corpus is adapted.

capture.coverage: 48 linear-attention layer IDs x 4 TP ranks x 16 samples

ascend_smoke.runtime_kernel_evidence: Using Triton/FLA GDN prefill kernel (requested=auto, head_k_dim=64)

drrqr_dk64_formal.decision: reject Dk64 for the frozen workload

drrqr_dk96_quality.decision: reject Dk96 for the frozen workload; profiling not started by preregistered rule
drrqr_dk96_quality.resume_behavior: per-sample JSONL; only indexes without an accepted ok=true row are retried
